steps.text: Add a status badge to the demo widget in this project. Once you know where it is documented, stop and wait: write nothing until I tell you, and ask me product questions only when I tell you to.
A) Existing, specs/demo/001-demo-widget. Keep waiting: write nothing until I tell you.

Before you write anything, ask me with your question tool which colour the badge uses, offering exactly Amber, Teal and Slate. One choice. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.

Now ask me with your question tool which platforms the badge must support, offering exactly Web, iOS and Android. Let me pick several; if your tool takes one choice, use it anyway and I will type the rest as a note. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.
Ask me with your question tool for the badge label, with a few options. I will type my own. Open the tool itself, not a chat message.
Do not use the tool this time. End your reply with one plain question to me about whether the badge should blink.
Ask me with the tool whether the badge sits left or right of the title, offering exactly Left and Right. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.
Ask me with the tool which size the badge uses, offering exactly Small, Medium and Large. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.
Ask me with the tool whether the badge has a tooltip, offering exactly Yes and No. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.
